answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake locked on a public terrace of escrowed deposits, visible to everyone. To stay active, the agent must send a regular heartbeat pulse proving liveness and real work; idle or duplicate identities lose their place. Honest behavior builds a reputation trail as clear as crystal, while a slashed stake makes each fake identity expensive, so running thousands of sock puppets costs more than any reward they could extract.
